deviations: Matched event-study sample keeps one copy of each Wave-2 control per treated station it is matched to (with replacement), giving 231,990 obs; the paper reports 186,499, so their pairing/deduplication evidently differs.
Deadline sample defined at station level as automation date equal to 2013-01-01 or 2014-01-01 (242 + 123 stations, matching the paper's station counts; 73 cities vs the paper's 84).
For the city-level search RD, cities with more than one station automation date (14) use the modal station date (earliest on ties).

Monthly running variable = calendar-month difference from the automation month (the automation month = 0, treated). Weather for AOD and searches is the station-month and city-month mean of the daily weather.

Residualization is run once on the full sample (station or city FE + month-of-year FE + 4 weather controls; singletons dropped). Subsample RDs use those residuals. rdrobust uses p=1, a triangular kernel, mserd bandwidth, cr1 clustering by city and default mass-points handling; the conventional estimate is reported.
notes: Attempts 1-2 explored the data (structure, sample counts, an rdrobust timing check on raw NO2); they printed no RESULT lines. Attempt 3 crashed because fixest dropped 19 singleton station-months in the AOD residualization; it was fixed with resid(na.rm=FALSE). Daily RD sample = 1,049,325 station-days with PM10 and full weather. The search city-month counts (8,661 mask, 8,590 filter) came out equal to the paper's stated pre-bandwidth counts without any tuning. The event-study window is 2012-01-01 to 2013-12-31. Treated = stations automated 2013-01-01. Reference = Nov-Dec 2012. Log PM10 drops 82 zero readings. README.pdf (in the mount) was read for data descriptions only. No runs hung.
